package store

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// Widen constructs a pgx.QueuedQuery directly and appends it to the batch's exported
// QueuedQueries slice, skipping the Queue method entirely -- so a guard that only tracks calls
// to Queue never sees this SQL at all.
func Widen(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, dyn string) {
	batch := &pgx.Batch{}
	batch.QueuedQueries = append(batch.QueuedQueries, &pgx.QueuedQuery{SQL: dyn})
	pool.SendBatch(ctx, batch)
}
